sources.title: Green Builder March/April 2024: Sustainable Products of the Year
Green Builder March/April 2025: Sustainable Products of the Year
Green Builder March/April 2026: Sustainable Products of the Year

products.product: 4-Element Induction Slide-In Convection Range, 30-inch, 6.4 cu. ft.
products.summary: This electric induction range heats cookware directly and responds quickly to temperature changes. Its convection oven and four cooking elements support everyday meals while avoiding combustion from a gas cooktop.

awards.sourceTitle: 2024 Green Builder Sustainable Products of the Year

products.summary: This ventless combination washer and heat pump dryer completes both stages without transferring clothes. Load-sensing controls adjust washing and detergent delivery, helping households conserve water and energy while using a standard 120-volt outlet.

awards.sourceTitle: 2024 Green Builder Sustainable Products of the Year

products.summary: Six induction zones heat cookware directly, with bridging for larger pans and two ovens for different meal sizes. Electric cooking avoids gas combustion indoors while offering responsive heat control and an easy-clean surface.

awards.sourceTitle: 2024 Green Builder Sustainable Products of the Year

products.summary: These modular LED downlights let homeowners change optics, trims and light engines while retaining the ceiling housing. Efficient illumination and replaceable components reduce electricity use and the material waste associated with replacing entire fixtures.

awards.sourceTitle: 2024 Green Builder Sustainable Products of the Year

products.summary: This WaterSense-certified toilet uses vacuum-assisted Stealth flushing at 0.8 gallons per flush to reduce household water use. Its concealed trapway simplifies cleaning, while the preassembled tank and large footprint ease replacement installations.

awards.sourceTitle: 2024 Green Builder Sustainable Products of the Year

products.product: ReAct Low-Carbon Cement, made using ReCarb
products.summary: ReAct is a cement ingredient made through Fortera's ReCarb process that can blend with or replace conventional cement. It gives construction teams a route to lower embodied emissions in home building materials.

awards.sourceTitle: 2024 Green Builder Sustainable Products of the Year

products.summary: Factory-made structural insulated panels sandwich an expanded-polystyrene core between oriented strand board skins. The system reduces construction waste and heating and cooling demand while providing an airtight, structurally strong enclosure for homes.

awards.sourceTitle: 2024 Green Builder Sustainable Products of the Year

products.summary: This noncombustible steel framing system supports decks with longer spans and fewer posts than typical wood framing. Recyclable components and a long service life reduce replacement needs while freeing usable space beneath elevated decks.
products.imageCredit: Photo: Fortress Building Products / Green Builder

awards.sourceTitle: 2024 Green Builder Sustainable Products of the Year

products.summary: Thermal modification reduces moisture in Ayous lumber and improves resistance to decay and insects. Used for ceilings, walls or rainscreens, it offers homeowners lightweight wood finishes with reduced maintenance needs.
products.imageCredit: Photo: GMX Group / Novawood North America / Green Builder

awards.sourceTitle: 2024 Green Builder Sustainable Products of the Year

products.summary: Smatrix Pulse wirelessly coordinates radiant floor heating and forced-air heating and cooling across multiple zones. Temperature sensing and automatic balancing help maintain room comfort while reducing unnecessary heating and supporting remote control.

awards.sourceTitle: 2024 Green Builder Sustainable Products of the Year

products.product: L Series Water Leak Damage Defense System (L1, L2 and L5)
products.summary: The L Series combines leak and freeze sensing, HVAC condensate protection and an automatic water shutoff valve. Alerts and coordinated equipment responses help households limit wasted water and damage from plumbing or condensate leaks.
products.imageCredit: Photo: Resideo / First Alert / Green Builder

awards.sourceTitle: 2024 Green Builder Sustainable Products of the Year

products.summary: This monitor measures electricity use directly at selected household circuits and displays real-time information in an app. Alerts and usage histories help owners identify unusual consumption and shift loads away from costly peak periods.

awards.sourceTitle: 2024 Green Builder Sustainable Products of the Year

products.product: Autonomous Control powered by BrainBox AI
products.summary: This cloud service optimizes HVAC operation using occupancy, weather and equipment data in buildings with Tracer SC+ controls. It can reduce energy use and operating costs for managed properties while maintaining occupant comfort.

awards.sourceTitle: 2024 Green Builder Sustainable Products of the Year

products.verificationNotes: Requires an existing Trane Tracer SC+ control system.

products.product: Infinity 24 Heat Pump with Greenspeed Intelligence
products.summary: A variable-speed compressor adjusts heating and cooling output to household demand instead of relying on full-capacity cycles. Paired with Infinity System Control, it maintains steadier temperatures, manages humidity and reduces energy use.

awards.sourceTitle: 2024 Green Builder Sustainable Products of the Year

products.product: Endeavor Line Classic Plus Series Universal Heat Pump RD17AZ
products.summary: The RD17AZ heat pump provides efficient heating and cooling while accommodating communicating or conventional controls. Its smaller condenser coil reduces refrigerant requirements, and broad system compatibility can simplify replacement of existing home equipment.

awards.sourceTitle: 2024 Green Builder Sustainable Products of the Year

products.product: Astra Beam Active Chilled Beam System
products.summary: A low-voltage fan moves room air through a hydronic coil for heating or cooling without conventional ductwork. The system offers efficient room conditioning and includes a condensate tray to manage cooling moisture.

awards.sourceTitle: 2024 Green Builder Sustainable Products of the Year

products.summary: Made with recycled wood and plastics, this capped composite decking resists moisture, rot and insects. Its CoolDeck technology reduces heat absorption, helping make outdoor living areas more comfortable with less routine upkeep.

awards.sourceTitle: 2024 Green Builder Sustainable Products of the Year

products.summary: Terrain+ combines reclaimed wood fibers and recycled polymers beneath protective capping on all four sides. It resists splintering, cracking and surface damage, giving homeowners durable decking that can enter AZEK's recycling program after use.
products.imageCredit: Photo: TimberTech (The AZEK Company) / Green Builder

awards.sourceTitle: 2024 Green Builder Sustainable Products of the Year

products.summary: These automated shades use low-power Ethernet motors and programmable controls to manage sunlight. Scheduled opening and closing can reduce summer solar heat gain or admit winter sun, helping homeowners manage indoor comfort and energy demand.

awards.sourceTitle: 2024 Green Builder Sustainable Products of the Year

products.summary: This low-emitting interior enamel resists scuffs and repeated washing in busy rooms. Its durable finish reduces touch-ups and repainting, while GREENGUARD certification and low-VOC formulation support lower chemical emissions inside the home.

awards.sourceTitle: 2024 Green Builder Sustainable Products of the Year

products.summary: Triple-pane A-Series windows reduce heat transfer to help maintain indoor temperatures, especially during long heating seasons. Durable composite and fiberglass exteriors resist weather, and indoor-air-quality certification supports selection for low-emitting home assemblies.

awards.sourceTitle: 2024 Green Builder Sustainable Products of the Year

products.product: Schneider Home (Pulse, Boost, Inverter and Charge)
products.summary: Schneider Home links a smart panel, battery, solar inverter and EV charger through one app. Coordinated storage and load control help households use solar electricity, reduce peak-rate purchases and maintain power during outages.

awards.sourceTitle: 2024 Green Builder Sustainable Products of the Year

products.summary: BlueWave combines modular batteries, inverter options and app-based monitoring in a residential storage system. It supplies backup electricity and supports time-of-use management, with capacity that can expand as household energy needs grow.
products.imageCredit: Photo: Blue Planet Energy / Green Builder

awards.sourceTitle: 2024 Green Builder Sustainable Products of the Year

products.product: IceStone Recycled Glass Countertops and Vanity Surfaces
products.summary: Recycled glass, cement and pigment form these countertop and vanity surfaces without resin or plastic binders. The material emits no VOCs and resists stains, giving households a durable surface that reuses discarded glass.

awards.sourceTitle: 2024 Green Builder Sustainable Products of the Year

products.product: Peninsula, Stratosphere and Hemisphere Carbon Negative Area Rugs
products.summary: These modular area rugs combine recycled ECONYL yarn with plant-based CQuest BioX backing. Their materials store more carbon than production releases, offering durable home floor coverings designed for recycling after use.

awards.sourceTitle: 2024 Green Builder Sustainable Products of the Year

products.summary: This whey-protein floor finish protects hardwood from scratches and wear while meeting stringent indoor emissions testing. Its single-component formulation avoids limited pot life, reducing leftover finish waste during home flooring projects.
products.imageCredit: Photo: Vermont Natural Coatings / Green Builder

awards.sourceTitle: 2024 Green Builder Sustainable Products of the Year

products.summary: Le Chic surfaces combine minerals and recycled materials in a stain- and moisture-resistant finish for home interiors. Manufacturing uses reused water and renewable electricity, reducing resource demand associated with producing durable surfaces.

awards.sourceTitle: 2024 Green Builder Sustainable Products of the Year

products.summary: PureTech uses a PVC-free core with renewable plant material and recycled content to create wood-look flooring. Waterproof protection and scratch resistance help households manage spills and pet wear while reducing reliance on virgin materials.

awards.sourceTitle: 2024 Green Builder Sustainable Products of the Year

products.product: Mycelium Collection of SRP Rigid Core TPU Flooring
products.summary: This rigid-core flooring incorporates plastic recovered from water bottles into durable planks and tiles. Its abrasion-resistant construction suits home interiors, and used flooring can be recovered as feedstock for new Mycelium products.

awards.sourceTitle: 2024 Green Builder Sustainable Products of the Year

products.summary: The Mineral Time Collection blends natural minerals and recycled materials into durable decorative surfaces. Lower crystalline silica content reduces a material hazard associated with fabrication, while the resilient finish supports long-lived home installations.

awards.sourceTitle: 2024 Green Builder Sustainable Products of the Year

products.summary: EcoStone provides travertine-look porcelain for indoor and outdoor projects, including thin large-format panels that use less raw material. Its durable, weather-resistant surface gives homeowners a carbon-neutral tile option described in the award coverage.

awards.sourceTitle: 2024 Green Builder Sustainable Products of the Year

products.summary: Rekindle tile combines a slip-resistant surface with built-in antimicrobial protection for the product itself. Its lack of VOC emissions supports indoor air quality, while durable tiles also suit outdoor living areas.

awards.sourceTitle: 2024 Green Builder Sustainable Products of the Year

products.summary: Staggered openings create an airflow path through this interior door, helping air circulate between rooms without a powered fan. Internal acoustic baffles preserve sound privacy while avoiding separate visible transfer grilles.

awards.sourceTitle: 2024 Green Builder Sustainable Products of the Year

products.summary: CONNECT combines indoor and outdoor air-quality monitoring with automatic ventilation responses and airflow checks. It helps maintain healthier air throughout the home, while remote diagnostics give installers a way to troubleshoot system performance.

awards.sourceTitle: 2024 Green Builder Sustainable Products of the Year

products.summary: A reusable smart filter frame monitors air quality and works with a compatible thermostat to activate HVAC circulation. Replaceable MERV 13 filters capture airborne particles, and replacement alerts help homeowners maintain filtration.

awards.sourceTitle: 2024 Green Builder Sustainable Products of the Year

products.product: Premium Cellulose Insulation with WALLSEAL Installation
products.summary: Made largely from recycled paper, this cellulose insulation fills wall cavities through the WALLSEAL installation system. Its dense application reduces air movement and heating and cooling demand, helping make homes less drafty.

awards.sourceTitle: 2024 Green Builder Sustainable Products of the Year

products.summary: Studulate bonds rigid insulation to dimensional lumber to interrupt heat flow through wall framing. Matching conventional framing depths allows builders to reduce thermal bridging while retaining familiar arrangements for cavity insulation, utilities and windows.

awards.sourceTitle: 2024 Green Builder Sustainable Products of the Year

products.summary: Savannah fencing uses recycled PVC and needs no painting, staining or sealing. Its reinforced privacy panels provide a low-maintenance boundary, with the article reporting high-wind resistance for panels six feet tall and shorter.

awards.sourceTitle: 2024 Green Builder Sustainable Products of the Year

products.summary: EcoTerra pavers use a cement-free facing mixture to reduce production emissions and prevent efflorescence. Dense, low-absorption surfaces resist stains and freeze-thaw damage, helping homeowners maintain durable patios, paths and other paved outdoor areas.

awards.sourceTitle: 2024 Green Builder Sustainable Products of the Year

products.summary: A recycled-plastic grid holds gravel in place while allowing rainwater to drain through driveways and paths. The flexible system limits rutting and puddling, helping households manage runoff and cope with freeze-thaw movement.

awards.sourceTitle: 2024 Green Builder Sustainable Products of the Year

products.summary: Software-controlled sprinkler heads shape watering patterns to match the lawn, reducing overspray and overlap. App controls and local weather data help homeowners adjust irrigation timing and track outdoor water use.

awards.sourceTitle: 2024 Green Builder Sustainable Products of the Year

products.summary: Wildwood combines recycled wood fiber and plastic into water-resistant cladding for rainscreen applications. It provides a wood-like exterior while resisting rot, insects and cracking, with less staining and painting maintenance than traditional wood.

awards.sourceTitle: 2024 Green Builder Sustainable Products of the Year

products.summary: This architectural zinc uses a lower-emission manufacturing process powered largely by renewable electricity. Its long service life and recyclability offer homeowners durable roofing or cladding materials with reduced embodied carbon.

awards.sourceTitle: 2024 Green Builder Sustainable Products of the Year

products.summary: Hardie Artisan fiber-cement lap siding provides a durable exterior that resists weather and fire damage. Its long service life can reduce replacement frequency, while cement absorbs some atmospheric carbon during use.

awards.sourceTitle: 2024 Green Builder Sustainable Products of the Year

products.summary: This engineered wood siding and trim retains carbon stored in its wood feedstock throughout its useful life. It provides exterior finishes whose published life-cycle assessments help homeowners compare material impacts.

awards.sourceTitle: 2024 Green Builder Sustainable Products of the Year
LP SmartSide Trim & Siding
LP SmartSide Trim & Siding

products.product: HelioWing Hurricane Edition Solar Power System
products.summary: This reinforced solar canopy generates electricity while serving as a carport, pergola or garden cover. Designed for high winds and snow loads, it supports optional battery storage and EV charging for home energy systems.

awards.sourceTitle: 2024 Green Builder Sustainable Products of the Year

products.product: Eagle (Tiger Neo) N-type TOPCon Solar Module
products.summary: These N-type TOPCon modules convert sunlight into electricity with improved low-light performance and limited annual degradation. Their output characteristics help homeowners generate more solar power over time, including in warmer operating conditions.

awards.sourceTitle: 2024 Green Builder Sustainable Products of the Year

products.summary: The H300 treats shower, bath and selected laundry water for reuse in non-drinking applications such as toilet flushing and irrigation. Recycling water at home reduces fresh-water demand and wastewater volumes while retaining residual heat.

awards.sourceTitle: 2024 Green Builder Sustainable Products of the Year

products.summary: TriStar XL adjusts pump speed to suit pool circulation and water-feature demands rather than running continuously at one speed. This helps pool owners reduce electricity use, equipment stress and operating noise.

awards.sourceTitle: 2024 Green Builder Sustainable Products of the Year

products.summary: This WaterSense-labeled controller schedules irrigation using weather, plant, soil and seasonal information to avoid unnecessary watering. Homeowners can manage schedules, review watering history and operate compatible smart-home voice controls through connected services.

awards.sourceTitle: 2024 Green Builder Sustainable Products of the Year

products.product: 6.3 Cubic Foot Smart Induction Slide-in Range with Convection and Air Fry
products.summary: This induction range heats compatible cookware directly and combines convection baking with air frying. Cookware sensing and compatibility feedback help households use energy efficiently while gaining precise stovetop temperature control.

awards.sourceTitle: LG 6.3 Cubic Foot Smart Induction Slide-in Range with Convection and Air Fry

products.product: 700 Series Front Load Laundry Pair ELFW7738AA and ELFE7738AA
products.summary: The laundry pair favors cold washing and shows the resource impact of cycle choices. A steam refresh option lets households freshen lightly worn clothing without running a full wash.

awards.sourceTitle: Electrolux Front Load Laundry Pair ELFW77388AA and ELFE7738AA

products.summary: This induction range combines flexible cooking zones with a convection oven offering steam and air fry modes. A water-only cleaning cycle helps households maintain the oven without specialized cleaning chemicals.

awards.sourceTitle: SKS 36-inch Pro Induction Range

products.summary: The Gold 17 adjusts compressor speed to heat and cool the home efficiently, including in cold weather. Built-in diagnostics and protective controls help installers identify faults and reduce component damage.

awards.sourceTitle: American Standard Gold 17 Multi-Speed Heat Pump

products.product: IDS Ultra Cold Climate Heat Pump
products.summary: This inverter heat pump maintains full heating capacity at 5 degrees Fahrenheit and continues operating at lower temperatures. It gives cold-climate households an electric option for space heating and cooling.

awards.sourceTitle: Bosch IDS Ultra Cold Climate Heat Pump

products.product: Hylex (Hybrid Flexible Single) Heat Pump System
products.summary: Hylex uses inverter-driven heat transfer for home heating and cooling in a compact unit. Compatibility with existing equipment can reduce replacement materials and installation work when updating a household system.

awards.sourceTitle: Samsung Hylex (Hybrid Flexible Single) Heat Pump System

products.verificationNotes: Existing indoor coil must have a thermal expansion valve for the reuse arrangement described in the article.

products.product: Domestic Hot Water Air-to-Water (DHW A2W) Heat Pump
products.summary: This outdoor heat pump supplies a combined heating, cooling and hot-water system. Bundled tanks, controls and fittings simplify equipment selection while heat-transfer operation reduces household energy demand compared with conventional heating.

awards.sourceTitle: Carrier Domestic Hot Water Air-to-Water (DHW A2W) Heat Pump

products.product: GeoSpring Smart Hybrid Heat Pump Water Heater
products.summary: GeoSpring uses heat-pump technology and scheduling controls to reduce water-heating energy use. App monitoring, leak detection and automatic shutoff help homeowners manage consumption and limit potential water damage.

awards.sourceTitle: GE Profile GeoSpring Smart Hybrid Heat Pump Water Heater

products.product: Solar Assisted Heat Pump Water Heater
products.summary: Outdoor evaporator panels collect heat from sunlight and surrounding air to supply domestic hot water. The system reduces reliance on resistance heating without drawing heat from rooms inside the home.

awards.sourceTitle: Smart Solar Solar Assisted Heat Pump Water Heater

products.summary: This heat pump provides electric space heating and cooling using R-454B refrigerant. WeatherGuard protection shields components from outdoor exposure, supporting equipment longevity while efficient operation helps reduce household utility costs.

awards.sourceTitle: Trane 15 Single-Stage Heat Pump with WeatherGuard

products.summary: Euroshield uses recycled rubber tires to create roofing with slate or shake appearances. The material diverts waste from disposal and offers homeowners durable roof coverings suited to severe weather exposure.

awards.sourceTitle: Euroshield Recycled Roofing

products.summary: These fiber-cement panels provide stucco-inspired or linear exterior finishes with water resistance and noncombustible cladding. Climate-specific options help homeowners select siding suited to local conditions while reducing vulnerability to exterior fire exposure.

awards.sourceTitle: James Hardie Hardie Architectural Panel

products.summary: ACRE turns discarded rice hulls into a wood-look material for indoor and outdoor uses. Its low-emission formulation and resistance to moisture, rot and pests support durable finishes with less reliance on harvested wood.

awards.sourceTitle: Modern Mill ACRE Wood Substitute

products.product: TrexSelect Decking with SunComfortable Heat Mitigating Technology
products.summary: This composite decking combines recycled and reclaimed materials with a reflective shell that reduces surface heat. Homeowners get boards that resist rot and warping without routine sanding, staining or sealing.

awards.sourceTitle: Trex TrexSelect Decking with SunComfortable Heat Mitigating Technology

products.summary: Newpoint concrete tiles offer fire resistance and selected hail-rated profiles for durable roofing. Reflective color options can reduce solar heat gain, while multiple profiles accommodate different home styles and some retrofit applications.
products.imageCredit: Photo: Westlake Royal Roofing / Green Builder

awards.sourceTitle: Westlake Royal Roofing Newpoint Concrete Roof Tiles

products.product: Second Nature Environmentally Conscious Door Collection
products.summary: These doors incorporate recycled or sustainably sourced wood fiber in engineered components that resist cracking and warping. Low chemical-emission certification supports indoor material choices while reducing reliance on virgin wood.

awards.sourceTitle: JELD-WEN Second Nature Environmentally Conscious Door Collection

products.summary: Diamond Glass uses thin laminated glass to provide hurricane-impact resistance with less material and weight. Lighter glazing reduces transport demands while giving homes a protective alternative to thicker impact-rated glass.

awards.sourceTitle: MITER Brands’ Diamond Glass Laminated Glass Unit

products.summary: These windows combine insulating vinyl frames, low-emissivity glass and argon-filled glazing to limit heat transfer. Regional glass packages help homeowners match thermal performance to climate while reducing ultraviolet exposure to furnishings.
products.imageCredit: Photo: Simonton / Cornerstone Building Brands / Green Builder

awards.sourceTitle: Cornerstone Building Brands Simonton 5500 Collection Vinyl Window

products.summary: Veris aluminum doors use thermal breaks to separate indoor and outdoor metal components, limiting heat transfer and condensation. Multiple opening styles and glazing options support large openings with improved thermal performance.

awards.sourceTitle: Therma-Tru Veris Collection

products.summary: This shower toilet combines adjustable personal washing with rimless bowl rinsing designed to limit water use. An automatic energy-saving mode reduces standby consumption when the toilet has not been used for 24 hours.

awards.sourceTitle: Duravit SensoWash u toilet

products.summary: WasteLAB Vox incorporates more than 70 percent recycled manufacturing materials, including recovered ceramic and foundry waste. Its deep basin gives homeowners a functional bathroom sink while diverting industrial byproducts from landfill.

awards.sourceTitle: KOHLER WasteLAB Vox Sink

products.summary: This bidet seat provides adjustable personal washing without an electrical connection. Controlled nozzles limit water use, while a quick-release mechanism and tool-free installation simplify cleaning and upgrades to an existing bathroom.

awards.sourceTitle: Niagara HydroTech Non-Electric Bidet Seat

products.summary: Recycled plastic legs elevate cabinets above the floor to reduce contact with leaking water. Adjustable height and a removable toe kick make leveling, cleaning underneath and reaching the work surface easier.

awards.sourceTitle: Cosmo Cabinets Plastic Leg Leveler System

products.summary: This recessed LED fixture combines lighting with heating and cooling air delivery. Combining ceiling openings can reduce penetrations through the building envelope while providing illumination and conditioned air in new or renovated rooms.

awards.sourceTitle: Fusion Air Lighting Downlight with Integrated Air Diffusion

products.verificationNotes: For ceilings up to 1 inch thick; compatible with standard 6-inch LED retrofit modules.

products.summary: ICON combines recycled post-industrial glass with a formulation containing less than one percent crystalline silica. The surface offers kitchen and bathroom finishes with recycled content and GREENGUARD Gold certification for low emissions.

awards.sourceTitle: Caesarstone ICON CSF – Advanced Fusion Surface

products.summary: SolidTech R uses recycled plastic and a natural stone recycled core instead of PVC. Its impact and scratch resistance gives households a durable flooring option that incorporates recovered material.

awards.sourceTitle: Mohawk SolidTech R Flooring

products.summary: This lime-and-water wall finish uses a low-odor, VOC-free formulation for interior surfaces. Its breathable coating offers homeowners a textured finish while avoiding the solvent emissions associated with some conventional paints.

awards.sourceTitle: Portola Paints Lime Wash

products.summary: These upholstery textiles combine a liquid barrier and embedded stain resistance with thermoplastic polyurethane backing. The fluorocarbon-free materials offer households soft, cleanable furnishings with a backing designed for lower production impacts.

awards.sourceTitle: Supreen Ultra-Soft Sustainable Textiles

products.summary: These porcelain slabs provide stone and marble appearances using mineral ingredients and recycled or reclaimed materials. Their durable, low-maintenance surfaces give homeowners finish options without added VOCs, PVC or formaldehyde.

awards.sourceTitle: Daltile Panoramic Elestial Porcelain Slabs

products.summary: These decorative panels turn discarded electronics, refrigerators and industrial plastics into recycled, recyclable surfaces. Waterproof construction and lightweight panels offer durable options for feature walls, screens and ceilings in home projects.
products.imageCredit: Photo: The Good Plastic Company / Green Builder

awards.sourceTitle: The Good Plastic Company M|R Walls x Polygood Collection

products.summary: This combined energy and heat recovery ventilator exchanges stale indoor air while recovering useful heat and managing humidity. App controls help homeowners adjust ventilation, including air circulation serving basements or crawlspaces.

awards.sourceTitle: HumiFresh Hybrid 200 ERV/HRV system

products.summary: This design tool estimates embodied carbon before materials and construction strategies are finalized. Designers can compare alternatives in real time, helping home projects reduce material-related emissions earlier in the planning process.

awards.sourceTitle: Arcadis Dynamic Carbon Model

products.product: BalancedHome Elite and Elite Plus ERVs
products.summary: These energy recovery ventilators bring in outdoor air and remove stale air while transferring heat and moisture. Automatic airflow adjustment and accessible controls help households maintain ventilation with less conditioning energy.

awards.sourceTitle: Panasonic BalancedHome Elite and Elite Plus ERVs

products.summary: VPTech combines continuous graphite-polystyrene insulation with a weather-resistant barrier and integrated seam sealing. The panels help reduce heat loss and air leakage while managing moisture behind a home's exterior cladding.

awards.sourceTitle: Henry Blueskin VPTech

products.summary: This open-cell spray foam insulates building cavities with a formulation containing renewable material and certified low chemical emissions. Certain approved configurations omit a separate ignition-barrier coating, reducing installation steps and material use.

awards.sourceTitle: BASF ENERTITE X Open-Cell Spray Foam

products.verificationNotes: Omitting an ignition-barrier coating is limited to approved configurations.

products.summary: ECOCELL cellulose batts and blankets use high recycled content to insulate framed and unfinished areas. The material provides thermal insulation and sound absorption, with formats suited to wall cavities, basements and crawlspaces.

awards.sourceTitle: Nu-Wool ECOCELL Batt and Blanket Insulation

products.summary: This open-cell spray foam reduces heat transfer in building cavities and incorporates renewable biobased material. It can simplify insulation in attics and crawlspaces, with ignition-barrier exceptions limited to approved applications.

awards.sourceTitle: Carlisle SFI SealTite PRO OCX

products.verificationNotes: Omitting an ignition barrier is limited to approved spaces and applications.

products.summary: ReliaHome manages major electrical loads alongside existing electrical equipment, solar and storage. Scheduling and automatic balancing help households control consumption and can reduce the need for costly electrical service upgrades.

awards.sourceTitle: ABB ReliaHome Smart Panel

products.summary: Automist detects heat and directs water mist toward a fire rather than wetting a broad area. Its targeted approach reduces suppression water use and helps protect occupants and property from fire damage.

awards.sourceTitle: Plumis Automist Fire Protection System

products.product: Flo Smart Water Monitor and Shutoff
products.summary: Flo monitors household water-use patterns, alerts owners to possible leaks and can shut off the supply. Fixture-level usage information also helps residents identify consumption patterns and set water conservation goals.

awards.sourceTitle: Moen Flo Smart Water Monitor and Shutoff

products.summary: This modular system adds circuit control and energy monitoring to home electrical infrastructure. App access helps residents manage selected loads and understand consumption, supporting lower operating costs and more deliberate electricity use.

awards.sourceTitle: Schneider Electric QO Smart Panel

products.summary: FocusPRO S200 combines heating and cooling schedules with air-quality and humidity monitoring. App-based away control and maintenance reminders help households reduce unnecessary conditioning and keep track of filter replacement needs.
products.imageCredit: Photo: Resideo / Honeywell Home / Green Builder

awards.sourceTitle: Resideo Honeywell Home FocusPRO S200 Smart Thermostat

products.summary: This curved photovoltaic roof tile integrates electricity generation into a roof's appearance. Designed for wind, hail and temperature exposure, it offers a potential solar option; the article described availability as forthcoming in 2025.

awards.sourceTitle: Jackery Solar Roof Tile

products.summary: PS50 combines battery storage, an inverter and load management to support household power needs. App controls help residents reserve energy for outages and shift consumption away from expensive peak-rate periods.

awards.sourceTitle: Savant Power Storage 50

products.summary: PWRcell 2 stores electricity from solar generation or the grid for later household use. It can supply backup power during outages and shift electricity purchases away from expensive peak periods.

awards.sourceTitle: Generac PWRcell 2

products.summary: This 440-watt solar module uses TOPCon cells to generate household electricity and reduce reliance on grid power. Its hail and weather resistance supports rooftop generation in locations exposed to severe conditions.

awards.sourceTitle: JinkoSolar EAGLE G6R

products.summary: This smart electrical panel monitors and controls household circuits while balancing available electrical capacity. Load management can accommodate new electric appliances without service upsizing, helping homeowners manage electrification costs and consumption.

awards.sourceTitle: SPAN Panel MLO 48

products.summary: AbleEdge breakers add controllable loads to a compatible home electrical system. Their modular approach helps households coordinate solar, storage and major appliances while potentially reducing the need for larger equipment upgrades.

awards.sourceTitle: Eaton AbleEdge Smart Breakers

products.summary: These locally produced adobe blocks use earth-based materials to reduce embodied carbon compared with conventional concrete masonry. Thermal and humidity regulation, plus fire and wind resistance, support comfortable, durable homes.
products.imageCredit: Photo: Nova Terra Inc. / Green Builder

awards.sourceTitle: Nova Terra Inc. EcoBlox

products.summary: These long structural sheathing panels add fire resistance to tested wall assemblies. Their length reduces seams and cutoffs, helping builders protect homes in wildfire-prone areas while limiting material waste.

awards.sourceTitle: Arclin Firepoint Fire-Resistant Building Material
Arclin Firepoint 10-foot OSB

products.summary: CaptureCrete incorporates carbon-capture and mineralization technology into concrete mixtures to bind atmospheric carbon dioxide. It gives builders a material option for reducing the carbon footprint of concrete used in home construction.

awards.sourceTitle: Carbon Limit CaptureCrete

products.summary: This deck framing uses recycled aluminum and mechanically attached components to reduce waste during installation. Resistance to moisture, corrosion, mold and fire offers homeowners a durable alternative to conventional wood framing.

awards.sourceTitle: TimberTech Aluminum Framing

products.product: Low Embodied Carbon (LEC) Cold-Formed Steel Framing and Accessories
products.summary: These framing products use steel from electric arc furnaces with higher recycled content to lower embodied carbon. Builders can reduce material-related emissions when specifying framing and accessories for new or renovated homes.

awards.sourceTitle: ClarkDietrich Low Embodied Carbon (LEC) Cold-Formed Steel Framing and Accessories

products.product: 360° Max Jets Third Rack Dishwasher with ProDry System
products.summary: This dishwasher adjusts wash time and temperature to the load and opens its door after a cycle to assist drying. These controls help households reduce unnecessary water and electricity use.

awards.sourceTitle: Whirlpool KitchenAid 360° Max Jets Third Rack Dishwasher with ProDry System

products.summary: These integrated refrigerator and freezer columns regulate temperatures closely to preserve food and reduce waste. Adaptive cooling and app-based monitoring help households match energy use to their daily routines.

awards.sourceTitle: SKS 36-inch Integrated Column Freezer and Refrigerator

products.product: 6.3-cubic-foot Induction Single Smart Range with Air Fry (LRIN6323YE)
products.summary: This induction range transfers heat directly to cookware and combines convection baking and air frying in one appliance. Its water-assisted cleaning cycle reduces cleaning effort and reliance on harsh cleaning products.

awards.sourceTitle: LG Induction Single Smart Range with Air Fry

products.summary: This sink-integrated dishwasher uses 1.6 gallons per cycle and combines spray cleaning with high-temperature sanitization and convection drying. It offers households a compact way to wash dishes while limiting water use.

awards.sourceTitle: Fotile 3-in-1 In-Sink Dishwasher

products.product: Water Recycling Bins Holdster Recycling Toilet
products.summary: This three-piece water collection system lets households reuse shower water for toilet flushing. Made from recovered and recycled plastics, the Holdster reduces demand for fresh water without replacing the existing toilet.

awards.sourceTitle: ShowerPot Water Recycling Bins Holdster Recycling Toilet

products.summary: This system combines citrus-based scale control with filtration to protect household plumbing and improve tap water quality. Its included Moen smart valve tracks water flow and alerts homeowners to leaks.

awards.sourceTitle: NuvoH2O Pro 7000 Saltless Water Softener System

products.summary: This toilet combines a rimless bowl with a protective ceramic glaze to simplify cleaning and use less flushing water. Its ceramics are produced using electric kilns powered largely by renewable energy.

awards.sourceTitle: Duravit Collection One Two-Piece Toilet

products.product: Voltex MAX Smart Hybrid Electric Heat Pump Water Heater
